title: Impactful week
content: So I just wanted to say hi again to my Mallworld friends. I have had some pretty impactful dreams including Mallworld dreams this week that has lead to real world epiphanies. I believe the part of it is a direct result of having an open minded community in terms of Mallworld/dreams. There's more to Mallworld that we have yet to understand and can't wait to continue the year in this thread. Good start to 2024.
